title: HTTPS Origin
description: HTTPS origin with no path, query, fragment, or userinfo. A trailing slash is allowed: a URL serializer writes an empty path as `/`, and RFC 3986 section 6.2.3 treats the two spellings as equivalent. Receivers compare these values by canonical origin (docs/reference/url-canonicalization.mdx#canonical-origin), so `https://host` and `https://host/` name the same origin.
